_about: Example ovhost inventory for the single OpenVibe host (openvibe-oregon). Copy to /etc/openvibe/host.json (root:root, 0640) and correct anything that differs on the machine; the real file is never committed. Paths, units, ports and env file locations come from OpenVibe.Network docs/roadmap-baseline/data/services.json and prod-snapshot.json (22 Sep 2026) and each repository's deploy/ directory. env.required lists NAMES only.
_drill: Restore drills (ovhost drill <service>): each service with a database has a drill block. The drill port is the service port + 10000 on 127.0.0.1. http://127.0.0.1:9 is a closed port, used where an empty value would fall back to a production service on loopback. An empty OV_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET stops a service from minting service tokens, so it cannot call other services with its identity. Loopback stays reachable from the drill sandbox (services need Network's public keys), so these overrides are what keep a drill away from production. _notes explain what is left on and why.

drill._notes: OV_EVENTS_INTERNAL_URL empty stops the dev_audit relay; INTERNAL_API_KEY empty falls back to the placeholder key, which makes the chrome site-copy job (paid LLM call through Live), avatar import and Live analytics calls return early. No switch: the ecosystem poller GETs every service readiness and release.json on loopback every 60 s (read-only). Discord bot login and the Resend email queue are gated by settings in the copy and reach only remote hosts, which the sandbox blocks. JWT_PRIVATE_KEY/JWT_PUBLIC_KEY come from the production env file and are only read.

live._databasesNote: analytics.db (1.7 GB, append-only pageviews) is left out of routine backups on purpose; add it here to include it.

drill._notes: Needs OpenVibe.Live 8a58aea or later (LIVE_DRILL, server/drill.js; requires checks the deployed checkout). LIVE_DRILL=1 refuses to start unless DB_PATH and DATA_DIR are outside the checkout and /opt/openvibe.live, HOST is loopback and PORT is not 3000, and never takes over the systemd socket. It then serves HTTP only: no RTMP/SRT/WHIP/SFU/JSMPEG listener, no WebSocket (upgrades get 403), no TURN credential, no jobs loop, restream or relay resume, AI job, Media reconciler, Events outbox, chat bridge, identity sync, deploy notice, star job or registry refresh. Every method but GET/HEAD/OPTIONS answers 403; net, fetch, child_process (git only), dgram and listen are guarded, so every other service looks down to it. All its files go to DATA_DIR ({tmp}/data: a fresh analytics.db and empty data directories; the per-location *_PATH values in live.env are ignored in a drill). rs-companion.db is not restored: the server never opens it. Compared: DB-only public reads; ignore lists drop what production changes in memory or every few seconds while someone is live (viewer counts, heartbeats, live thumbnails, recording state) and the one Media lookup (recently-online vod_thumbnail). /api/streams/channel/japaneseoldguy/live is the star channel: any channel that exists works. /release.json is not compared: production computes it at its own boot, so a public/-only deploy without a restart would make it differ. EVENTS_URL, the client secret and MEDIA_URL are blanked as a second switch. Not run on the host yet.

drill._notes: Needs OpenVibe.Media 6e74eb0 or later (MEDIA_DRILL, server/drill.js; requires checks the deployed checkout). MEDIA_DRILL=1 refuses to start unless DB_PATH is outside the checkout and /opt/openvibe.media, HOST is loopback and PORT is not 4100. It then serves HTTP only: no app seeding or JWKS refresh, no tiering sweep, health job, junk sweep, clip re-cuts, copy verification, jobs worker, invariant scans, disk guardian, thumbnail cleanup, object purge, backfill, orphan-recording finalize or Events relay, and no webhook (the apps table's URLs are production's). It writes no file and creates no directory, and never opens a file path from the database: every byte route (/v and /c bytes, /t, /a, /f, /o, paste screenshots, live frames) answers 503; watch pages and /browse render from the copy. Every method but GET/HEAD/OPTIONS answers 403, /auth/* 503; net, fetch, child_process (git only: no ffmpeg or ffprobe), dgram and listen are guarded. /api/ready drops the storage and remote-tier checks (mode: drill). The storage paths from media.env move under {tmp}/storage (never created) as a second switch; THUMBNAILS_PATH stays production's, read-only in the sandbox, because /browse counts the thumbnail directory in its tab bar (the drill lists it and serves none of it). /browse caches its tab counts for 60 s in production: take the backup right before the drill. EVENTS_URL and the client secret are blanked too. Not run on the host yet.

Drills ONE app: docs (both database kinds; spawns no external program; every path has an env override). Its unit's ExecStart/WorkingDirectory come from drill.unit, and the comparison runs against docs' own port. DATA_DIR takes a directory, so both copies land in {tmp}/data under their production names. TOOLS_JOB_RESULTS=local keeps the job pruner from deleting production Media objects for expired jobs in the copy; EVENTS_PUBLISH=off keeps the copy's pending outbox rows from being republished; TOOLS_JOBS_CONCURRENCY=0 runs no job. What still runs, on the copy only: job recovery and pruning, analytics aggregation, upload retention (all under {tmp}). yt, maps and food open data/analytics.db relative to the checkout: drill one with drill.unit + a {tmp} data dir + bind over apps/<app>/data (plus YT_PROXY= for yt) until Tools adds DATA_DIR there. Not run on the host yet.

openre._note: Release layout: the service runs from /opt/openre.stream/current and deploys with its own deploy/scripts/deploy.sh (release | api | workers). units are the API and the session coordinator. workerUnits are the transport workers: one instance per release (openre-rtmp-ingest@<release>), started by deploy.sh workers, drained by the coordinator when a newer generation is ready, and exiting on their own. ovhost lists them in status/validate and never starts, stops or restarts them (the inventory refuses a worker unit in units).

drill._notes: Only openre-api starts (command; the working directory and the non-secret Environment= come from openre-api.service). It never runs a transport, a coordinator or the event relay in any mode. OPENRE_DRILL=1 (OpenRe 5e86ea7 and later) also makes it read-only: writes, /play/ (which would pull from production's worker on loopback) and sign-in (which would redeem codes at Network) answer 503. The coordinator and the workers refuse to start. The event relay and Media calls are off. EVENTS_URL and OV_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET empty and MEDIA_URL on the closed port are the same switches for releases before 5e86ea7. Left on (read-only): the Network JWKS GET on loopback. Not compared: ingest_sessions and workers (they change whenever someone streams or a generation rolls over) and /api/ready (it reports live worker heartbeats).
